issue.title: Pomodoro themes — remembered, hideable, renameable, and colored everywhere
issue.description: Every Pomodoro-name menu (Bob Mac Capture, zsh, and the Obsidian pickers) lists today's names first and then previously used themes, and accepting a row submits exactly the name it shows. Ctrl+D hides a stale theme from suggestions in place, with undo. One bob transaction renames a theme across every daily note in a single revertable commit. Each theme wears a stable, learnable hue — in Obsidian Live Preview and Reading view, the plan block, Stats, Mac Capture, the CLI, tmux, and the menu bar — from one rule owned by bob.

Chezmoi mac pom prepends catalog ■ swatches from bob themes list -a -f json on existing re-syncs; title text stays untinted; exempt/unknown/failed themes leave the title unchanged. busted tests/hammerspoon 192 ok.
